round_1_contract: Run one predeclared paired seed independently at the largest and smallest stable SAD endpoints. This node alone cannot verify either claim.

future_acceptance.endpoint_ordering: Across at least five paired seeds, MSW2(smallest SAD) < MSW2(largest SAD) with a paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval for largest-minus-smallest strictly above zero.
future_acceptance.rank_association: A later predeclared multi-direction round must show positive rank association between geometry eigenvalue and MSW2 with uncertainty.
future_acceptance.claim_1_scope: Generation-preference ordering only; the eigenvector definition and geometry construction are checked separately.

integrity_failure: The verifier exits nonzero on non-finite samples or losses, wrong step/sample/projection counts, a failed exact-setup audit, metric disagreement, checker failure, or a negative control that is not rejected.
